entities.summary: Douglas Joseph Cardinal is a Canadian architect based in Ottawa, Ontario. His architecture is influenced by his Indigenous heritage, as well as European Expressionist architecture. Cardinal designed the Canadian Museum of History in Gatineau, Quebec, and the National Museum of the American Indian in Washington, DC. Douglas Cardinal was a architects & engineers from Calgary (b. 1934-03-07, Calgary). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
